optimized_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT time_dim.t_time_sk
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE time_dim.t_hour = 8 AND time_dim.t_minute >= 30
) AS td
INNER JOIN store_sales
    ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = td.t_time_sk
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT household_demographics.hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE household_demographics.hd_dep_count = 0
) AS hd
    ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT store.s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE store.s_store_name = 'ese'
) AS st
    ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
ORDER BY COUNT(*)
LIMIT 100
